annotations_dropped.text_preview: 3. Accordingly, the cause of action regarding inaction on the part of the authorities has been rendered infructuous.

Accordingly, WPA No. 6460 of 2024 is disposed of by keeping on record the report filed by the respondent nos. 4 to 6 and granting liberty to the petitioner and any other aggrieved party to challenge the decision taken by the respondent auth

Since the said decision was disclosed to the petitioner only by way of the report for the first time, the appropriate forum/court taking up the challenge, shall duly consider such fact while considering the question of delay if any.

6. It is made clear that the contentions of the parties regarding such proposed challenge have not been gone into on merits by this Court and it will be open to the appropriate forum/court to decide all the issues independently in accordanc
